title: Knight-Service

inlines.v: KNIGHT-SERVICE, noun In English feudal law, a tenure of lands held by knights on condition of performing military service, every possessor of a knight's fee, or estate originally of twenty pounds annual value, being obliged to attend the king in his wars.
